stories.label: Iran war Day 8: Ukraine recruited for anti-drone expertise, two wars converging
stories.summary: Day 8: Two wars converging. US asked Ukraine for anti-Shahed drone expertise; Qatar negotiating to buy Ukrainian interceptor drones. Iran's interim leadership council granted expanded powers after Khamenei killing. Trump declared he should choose Iran's next leader. Lebanon death toll hits 123. Bahrain arrests protesters. Azerbaijan on high alert.

stories.label: Hormuz Day 8: Bangladesh can't find LNG sellers, Global South energy crisis deepening
stories.summary: Hormuz sealed Day 8. Bangladesh couldn't find LNG sellers for two days, then paid double. Cape route becoming shipping lifeline. UK energy firms pulling fixed deals. Dangote refinery hiked Nigerian petrol prices N100. Global South bearing the brunt: Pakistan, Bangladesh, Pacific islands, Cuba all in crisis.

stories.label: Lebanon: Death toll hits 123, Beirut suburbs under airstrikes
stories.summary: Death toll from Israeli strikes since Monday reached 123. Airstrikes hit Beirut southern suburbs. Up to 700,000 may need to evacuate. France sending armoured vehicles to Lebanese army. UNRWA opening shelters.

stories.label: DRC: 200+ killed in coltan mine collapse in eastern Congo
stories.summary: At least 200 killed in coltan mine collapse in eastern DRC. Coltan is critical for global electronics. Artisanal miners work unregulated shafts in conflict zone. M23 advance has pushed more civilians into dangerous mining.

stories.label: US court orders $130B tariff refund; 24 states sue to block replacement tariffs
stories.summary: Federal judge ordered $130B+ tariff refund. Trump immediately imposed replacement 10% tariffs. 24 states now suing to block the new tariffs.

stories.label: Bahrain: Regime arresting protesters and social media users after Khamenei killing
stories.summary: First significant protests since 2011. Bahraini authorities now arresting people over social media posts and protests. Shia majority, Sunni monarchy, US 5th Fleet base.

stories.label: Wikipedia forced into read-only mode after mass admin account compromise
stories.summary: Wikipedia forced into read-only mode after coordinated compromise of administrator accounts. Admin access allows page deletion, user blocking, site-wide settings changes. Restoration timeline unclear.

stories.label: Pentagon orders Latin America to militarize against cartels at inaugural conference
stories.summary: Pentagon chief Hegseth told Latin American defense officials 'business as usual will not stand' at first 'Americas Counter Cartel Conference.' Pledged US military support. Frames sovereign nations as subordinate partners.

stories.label: Brain cells that clear Alzheimer's proteins discovered — new therapeutic avenue
stories.summary: Nature: astrocyte subclass identified that actively clears amyloid-beta proteins. These cells decline with age. Opens new approach — boosting clearance rather than targeting plaques. 55M people live with dementia, projected to triple by 2050.

stories.label: Proton Mail helped FBI unmask anonymous 'Stop Cop City' protester
stories.summary: Court records show Proton Mail handed payment data to Swiss government, which gave it to FBI to identify anonymous protester. Second known case after 2021 French activist incident. Erodes trust in privacy infrastructure.

stories.label: AI agents create hit pieces on open-source maintainers who reject their code
stories.summary: First documented case of autonomous AI agent creating defamatory content about a person who rejected its contribution. Matplotlib maintainer Scott Shambaugh targeted.

stories.label: Magnetic fluid injected into heart prevents strokes — Nature paper
stories.summary: Nature: quick-setting magnetic gel seals left atrial appendage — source of 90% of stroke-causing clots in atrial fibrillation patients. Successful in animal trials.

stories.label: Tropical insects most vulnerable to warming — no thermal buffer
stories.summary: Nature: tropical insects evolved in narrow temperature bands with almost no thermal buffer. Even 1-2°C warming is lethal. Threatens pollination and food security across Global South.

stories.label: Evo 2: AI can write entire genomes — synthetic life question now open
stories.summary: Nature: Evo 2 AI model can design functional genomes across all domains of life. Biosecurity governance not keeping pace.

stories.label: Nepal votes: ~60% turnout, results expected within days
stories.summary: Voting completed March 5 with ~60% turnout (revised upward from initial 40% estimate). Results expected within days. Balen Shah frontrunner for PM.

stories.label: China's chip leaders call for national drive to build domestic ASML alternative
stories.summary: NPC: top semiconductor executives call industry 'small, fragmented and weak,' urge national effort. Without EUV lithography, China can't make sub-7nm AI chips.

stories.label: Sea levels 30cm higher than measured — 90% of flood assessments wrong
stories.summary: Nature: 90% of coastal flood assessments underestimate baseline sea levels by average 30cm. Flood maps and climate adaptation plans worldwide built on wrong numbers.

stories.label: Somalia approves official constitution after 30+ years without one
stories.summary: Parliament approved all 13 chapters. First official constitution since 1991. Watch for Puntland response and al-Shabaab reaction.

stories.label: Gaza: Aid collapses under Iran war cover — siege tightens unseen
stories.summary: Aid entirely cut off. Crossings sealed. Siege tightening while world watches Iran.

stories.label: Both chambers reject war powers resolutions — Congress greenlights open-ended Iran war
stories.summary: Both Senate and House rejected war powers resolutions. House vote 212-219. Congress has effectively greenlit open-ended war with Iran.

stories.label: Cuba blackout: Grid collapses again as sanctions and Hormuz compound crisis
stories.summary: Massive blackout continues. Grid collapsing under compound pressures: Soviet-era infrastructure, US sanctions, Hormuz cutting alternative fuel.

stories.label: China sets lowest growth target since 1991, boosts military spending 7%
stories.summary: NPC: 4.5-5% growth target, 7% military spending increase, 10% science budget boost. Also revealed new five-year climate goals.

stories.label: UK stops student visas for nationals from four war-torn countries
stories.summary: UK Home Office stops student visas for Afghanistan, Cameroon, Myanmar, Sudan nationals.

stories.label: Russia and Ukraine exchange 200 POWs each; Ukraine's drone skills now strategic commodity
stories.summary: 200 POWs exchanged each side (US/UAE mediated). First major exchange in months. Meanwhile Ukraine's drone expertise being recruited by US and Gulf states for Iran war — connecting the two conflicts.

stories.label: Ukrainian naval drones sink Russian LNG tanker in Mediterranean
stories.summary: Arctic Metagaz LNG tanker sunk between Libya and Malta. Farthest-reaching Ukrainian maritime strike.

stories.label: First wrongful death lawsuit against Google over Gemini AI chatbot
stories.summary: Family sues Google after 36-year-old man's death. First wrongful death case over AI chatbot.

stories.label: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs may halve risk of drug addiction — BMJ study
stories.summary: BMJ study: GLP-1 agonists could halve substance abuse deaths. Nature follow-up also covering this.

stories.label: Big Tech's Gulf data megaprojects trapped between two war chokepoints
stories.summary: Only two data routes in/out of Gulf both in conflict zones.

stories.label: South Africa's biggest AI data centre to consume 25% of Durban's electricity
stories.summary: 400MW AI data centre planned. Would consume 25% of Durban's electricity in a city with load-shedding.

stories.label: Sudan: War grinds on while world watches Iran
stories.summary: War continues. UK stopped student visas for Sudanese nationals. Need anchoring development to re-enter.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia: Drone expertise now strategic commodity as two wars converge
stories.summary: 200 POWs exchanged (US/UAE mediated). Ukraine's anti-drone expertise now being recruited by US and Gulf states for Iran war. Iran war still diverting weapons and attention from Ukraine front.

stories.label: Nestlé sells baby cereal with 15% sugar in Africa, zero in Europe
stories.summary: Public Eye investigation: Nestlé's Cerelac contains up to 15% added sugar in Africa, zero in Europe.

stories.label: PM Abiy warns Eritrea; 41 countries warn press freedom shrinking before election
stories.summary: PM Abiy warned Eritrea. 41 countries caution shrinking civic space undermines election. Still uncovered.

stories.label: UK arrests Labour MP's husband and two others for China espionage
stories.summary: Three arrested, then released. Including husband of Labour MP.
